event.analysis_window: 2022-06-15 to 2022-06-29 daily point series; regional accumulation through 2022-07-30
event.window_semantics: Point-series pulse, cooling, and wind tests use the 2022-06-15 to 2022-06-29 daily records; regional precipitation uses the package-supplied accumulated regional summaries.

formulas.cooling_c: mean of each point series' available daily temperature field on 2022-06-15 and 2022-06-16 minus that same series' temperature on the peak-rain day
formulas.peak_day: date of maximum daily precipitation in each point series
formulas.pulse_share_pct: 100 * sum(precipitation from 2022-06-20 through 2022-06-22) / sum(precipitation over 2022-06-15 through 2022-06-29)
formulas.regional_mean_mm: mean of ERA5-Land, GPM IMERG, and CHIRPS regional accumulated precipitation means
formulas.regional_spread_pct: 100 * (maximum regional mean - minimum regional mean) / regional_mean_mm
formulas.wind_ceiling: NASA POWER maximum wind < 10 m/s and Open-Meteo maximum wind < 40 km/h

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields and final computed label.
criteria.name: answer_schema

criteria.description: Computes peak date, peak precipitation, pulse shares, cooling values, regional precipitation, and wind maxima within 0.1 units.
criteria.name: numeric_anchors

criteria.description: Applies the pulse-share, cooling, regional-mean, regional-spread, and wind-ceiling formulas to the stated windows.
criteria.name: formula_application

criteria.name: threshold_ledger

criteria.description: Derives wet_cooling_monsoon_pulse from the pass state and rejects wind-led or heat-led labels through numeric thresholds.
